{{short description|Russian-British theoretical physicist}}
'''Arkady Alexander  Tseytlin'''  FRS (Аркадий Александрович Цейтлин; born August 31, 1956, in Moscow) is a Russian and British theoretical physicist. He works on [[superstring theory]] and the [[AdS/CFT correspondence]].<!-- <ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.fpff.ru/node/78 |title=Цейтлин Аркадий Александрович {{!}} Фонд поддержки фундаментальной физики (Foundation for Fundamental Physics Support)|archive-date=2016-08-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160821184441/http://www.fpff.ru/node/78 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=PomeranchukPrize>{{cite web|url=https://itmp.msu.ru/en/news/arkady-tseytlin-was-honored-with-the-isaac-pomeranchuk-prize-international-award-for-theoretical-physics |title=Arkady Tseytlin was honored with the Isaac Pomeranchuk Prize |website=Institute for Mathematical and Theoretical Physics, Lomonosov Moscow State University|date=24 May 2023}}</ref> -->

Tseytlin graduated from [[Moscow State University]] with Master degree in physics in 1979. In 1984, he obtained his PhD from [[Lebedev Physical Institute]] (under the supervision of [[Efim Fradkin|E. S. Fradkin]])  and  joined the academic staff there. Since 1992, he has been a professor at [[Imperial College London]].<ref name=inspire>{{cite web|url=https://inspirehep.net/authors/985553 |title=Arkady Tseytlin (Imperial College London and Lebedev Institute)|website=inspirehep.net }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Profile: Professor Arkady Tseytlin|website=Imperial College London|url=https://profiles.imperial.ac.uk/a.tseytlin}}</ref>

Tseytlin has made important contributions to the development of modern string theory. In particular, he,  with E. S. Fradkin, developed the sigma-model approach to string dynamics in curved spacetime and established the central role of the Born-Infeld action in the  open string theory.<ref>{{cite journal|url=http://jetpletters.ru/ps/1443/article_21959.pdf|author=Fradkin, E. S.|author2=Tseytlin, A. A.|year=1985|title=Fields as excitations of quantized coordinates|journal=JETP Lett|volume=41|issue=4}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Tseytlin, A. A.|year=2001|title=Sigma model approach to string theory effective actions with tachyons|journal=Journal of Mathematical Physics|volume=42|issue=7|pages=2854–2871|doi=10.1063/1.1376129|arxiv=hep-th/0011033}} [https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0011033 arXiv preprint]</ref> He also constructed,  with R. R. Metsaev, a superstring action in [[anti-de Sitter space]], which plays a central role in the duality between gauge fields and strings and underlies the exact solution of the N=4 supersymmetric [[Yang-Mills theory]] based on [[Integrable system|integrability]].<ref name=researchcom>{{cite web|title=Arkady A. Tseytlin|website=research.com|url=https://research.com/u/arkady-a-tseytlin}}</ref>

In 2011, Tseytlin was awarded the [[John William Strutt, Lord Rayleigh Medal and Prize|Rayleigh Medal and Prize]] of the UK-based [[Institute of Physics]]. In 2023, he was awarded the International  [[Pomeranchuk Prize]]. In 2025,  he was elected a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] of the UK.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-20 |title=Exceptional scientists elected as Fellows of the Royal Society |url=https://royalsociety.org/news/2025/05/new-fellows/ |access-date=2025-05-22 |website=Royal Society |language=en}}</ref><!--
